verdict.rationale: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is a cloud platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is an applicable axis. A probe confirms an official MCP server documented at github.com/oracle/mcp, but the pack has no detail on which services or tools it exposes, how to set it up or authenticate, or whether connecting an agent works in practice. missing for 10: documentation of the MCP server's tool and service coverage, setup and authentication steps, and independent or hands-on confirmation of connecting an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://github.com/oracle/mcp
